portInfo.description: Hurghada Port sits on Egypt’s western Red Sea coast near the Gulf of Suez entrance, about 370 km south of Suez per the Maritime Transport & Logistics Sector port page. MTS describes tourism, yacht, cruise and ferry traffic (including Hurghada–Duba and Hurghada–Sharm links) and lists a modern passenger lounge of 900 m² with inspection equipment, plus a planned additional travel hall. The detailed berth table shows a single Passengers berth 330 m / 10 m. Land area 43,040 m² and navigational waterway depth 15 m are also tabulated. Separately, AD Ports Group announced commencement of cruise and ferry terminal services at Hurghada, Safaga and Sharm El Sheikh on 19 May 2026 under its 15-year Red Sea Ports Authority concession. Door GPS remains null; MTS contact address text on the page references Safaga — not treated as the Hurghada street address.
